remarks: Exceptional Investment Opportunity! Proud to present this lucrative multi-unit property located in a high-demand neighborhood of Stamford. Investors will benefit from the property's strong rental history and consistent income stream. Prime location close to town's vibrant amenities, Stamford Hospital, UConn, the train station, and public transportation. Whether you're an experienced investor or looking to expand your portfolio, this property presents tremendous potential for cash flow and growth. Don't miss this rare opportunity. Reach me today for more information or to schedule a viewing! Great Deal! Won't last!!!  Highest & best by 5 pm on Tuesday.
